blocks.text: Privacy Policy

Welcome to the Black Pearl Painters Web Site (the “Site”). This Site is intended to be an information resource for Web site visitors and our clients. This privacy policy is intended to inform visitors of the ways in which this Site collects information and how we use it.
Information We Collect

We collect information which visitors provide. For example, users may provide us their e-mail addresses to request information, or send us their mailing addresses so we may send materials or information that visitors have requested. In this way, we may collect the following information about our visitors: name, title, business address and telephone number, product usage and attitudes, as well as preferences for content, numbers of visits and length of time spent on the Site.

We use the information our visitors provide to respond to questions or requests regarding Black Pearl Painters, our products and services, or our Site; to improve Site content; and to send visitors periodic mailings and/or e-mails or call visitors about Black Pearl Painters services and products or upcoming events.
Cookies

Cookies are pieces of information stored by a visitor’s web browser on behalf of a Web site and returned to the Web site on request. Our Site uses cookies when a registered user is logged into our Site to help us manage the Site, improve features of the Site and understand usage patterns. The information that may be maintained by a cookie may include: the pages visited on the Site; the date and time of the visit; the internet address (URL or IP address) of the referring site; the domain name and IP address from which the access occurred; the version of browser used; the capabilities of the browser; and the search terms used on our search engines. The Site may use cookies for two purposes: to carry data about your current session at the Site from one Web page to the next, and to identify you to the Site. A cookie cannot read data off a visitor’s hard drive.

Some pages of our Site may not function properly if the cookies are turned off. Visitors should consult their web browser’s Help documentation for more information about how to turn cookies on and off for their browser.

In the course of ensuring network security and consistent service for all users, Black Pearl Painters employs software programs to do such things as monitor network traffic, identify unauthorized access or access to nonpublic information, detect computer viruses and other software that might damage Black Pearl Painters computer systems or the network, and monitor and tune the performance of Black Pearl Painters network. In the course of such monitoring, these programs may detect such information as e-mail headers, addresses from network packets, and other information. Information from these activities is used only for the purpose of maintaining the security and performance of Black Pearl Painters networks and computer systems.
Use of Personal Information

The personal information we maintain will be held by Black Pearl Painters and may be used by Black Pearl Painters, other associated companies (details of which are available on request), or Black Pearl Painters agents, partners or licensees. We do not sell, exchange or otherwise distribute visitor information without visitors’ consent, except to the extent required by law, in accordance with visitors’ instructions, or as set out below
Agents and Service Providers.

* We sometimes contract with other companies and individuals to perform functions or services on our behalf, such as hosting this Site, sending e-mail messages, and making phone calls on our behalf. They may have access to personal information, such as addresses, needed to perform their functions, but are restricted from using it for purposes other than providing services for Black Pearl Painters.
Business Transfers.

* As we continue to develop our business, we might sell or buy assets. In such transactions, Web site visitor information generally is one of the transferred business assets. Therefore, if either Black Pearl Painters itself or substantially all of Black Pearl Painters assets were acquired, visitor information may be one of the transferred assets.
Legal Matters.

* Black Pearl Painters reserves the right to disclose any information about visitors and their use of this Site without prior permission if Black Pearl Painters has a good faith belief that such action is necessary to: (a) protect and defend the rights, property or safety of Black Pearl Painters or its affiliates or subsidiaries, other users of this Site, or the public; (b) enforce the Terms of Use for this Site; or (c) respond to claims that any content violates the rights of third-parties. We may also disclose information as we deem necessary to satisfy any applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request.
External Links

This Web site may include links to other Web sites whose privacy policies we do not control. Once visitors leave our servers, use of any information visitors provide is governed by the privacy policy of the operator of the third party site.
Information Security

All information gathered on our Site is securely stored within the Black Pearl Painters-controlled database. The database is stored on servers secured behind a firewall and access to the servers is password-protected and is strictly limited. However, as effective as our security measures are, no security system is impenetrable. We cannot guarantee the security of our database, nor can we guarantee that visitor information will not be intercepted while being transmitted to us over the Internet. We ask that visitors do their part, by maintaining strictly confidential any computer passwords and eBusiness usernames and passwords used to access the Internet or this Site.
Storage and Access to Information
This Site and all information collected through this Site is collected, stored, and processed in the United States and Canada.

You can ask to review the information that we maintain about you or to correct, update, or delete any inaccurate information that we maintain about you at any time. Your request must be submitted in writing. We may take a reasonable period of time to respond. If you request the deletion or change of inaccurate information on our system, such information may be retained for a period in our backup systems as a precaution against systems failures. Some information may be retained for longer periods as required by law, contract or auditing requirements.
Your Information and Opting-Out

If you do not wish to receive telephone contact or periodic mailings or emails concerning new products and services or upcoming events, you may opt-out of receiving such information by sending us a written request to the address listed below or by following the opt-out instructions in an e-mail you receive from us.
Third Party Vendors

Links may be provided on the Black Pearl Painters web site to third party vendors and other company sites that are not affiliated with Black Pearl Painters. Any web site visited via a link from this site is solely the responsibility of the vendor, merchant, or other party providing the site. The content of, including materials and information contained on, any site to which you link from this site is solely the responsibility of the provider of that web site. Any transactions that you enter into with a vendor, merchant or other party listed in this site or linked from this site are solely between you and that vendor, merchant or other party.
Children’s Privacy

Our Services – including our Site and Apps – are intended for general audiences and are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from our Services from users in this age group.
Policy Updates

This privacy policy was last updated on March 21, 2025. We may update this privacy policy from time to time. When we do so, changes in our privacy policy will be effective immediately. If you are a regular visitor to this Site, we recommend that you check this privacy policy on a regular basis.
